signIn.title: Welcome to LexFlow
signIn.lead: Sign in with your email and password to continue.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Protect your account by asking for a second factor at every sign-in: a code from an authenticator app or a code sent by email.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.hint: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

totp.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or another).
totp.qrAlt: QR code to set up the authenticator app
totp.key: Or type this key into the app:

create.title: Create your office
create.lead: You are not part of any office yet. Create yours to get started; you will be the office administrator. If you received an invitation, open the link in the email.
create.name: Office name

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.lead: The person receives an email with the invitation link, valid for 7 days. Anyone without an account creates one from the same link.

organization.title: Office
organization.name: Office name

organization.mfaHint: Members without a second factor lose access to office data until they turn it on and sign in again.
